messages:
kate: Quick kickoff for a pricing-page experiment bundle: compact FAQ, two tier-name families, and a micro-calculator + soft lead routing. Goal: clearer messaging, better demo signups, and a small lift in trial starts. Launch: Fri 09:00 PT behind flag.

jason: +1. For tier names let's try playful vs utilitarian (e.g., 'Spark / Propel / Command' vs 'Starter / Business / Enterprise'). We should map the names to one-line benefit bullets.

sophia: I'll own FAQ edits and the launch post blurb. Plan to surface 5 top Qs and one-sentence answers. Will add a short benchmark narrative about typical token usage for a 10-dev app to justify pricing. Draft by Thu AM.

noah: Dev note: micro-calculator will call /api/estimate-v1 and return monthly and annual estimates. Feature flag = pricing_bundle_v3. Routing: if estimated_arr >= 40k -> create inbound lead to sales-inbound, otherwise to nurture-sdr. Collector should include variant_id. ETA 2 dev days if copy/design final.

kate: For the launch post, include a short benchmark paragraph: "We tested 3 workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) and the estimator shows X token ranges for a 10-dev team". Keep it concise and link to a blog/data appendix.

jason: Analytics: fire events pricing:calculator_open, pricing:calculator_submit, pricing:variant_choice. Expose experiment_key in page context. Primary metric = trial-start rate; secondary = estimator engage rate and demo requests. Baseline conv = 3.9%, target +0.4pp.

sophia: Draft blurb (shareable): "New: clearer pricing and an estimator to help teams plan costs. We ran internal benchmarks to show typical workloads. Try the estimator or book a demo." Will post to product-announcements + newsletter if results look good.

noah: UX detail: calculator should be a popover with 3 fields (seats, avg tokens/person/month, billing cadence) and two CTAs: Estimate and Talk to sales. If Talk to sales is clicked, prefill and POST to /api/inbound-lead with lead_source=pricing_calculator.

kate: Routing nuance: if user checks "we have compliance needs" add priority flag. Also include user_country and consent_state. Sales-ops to confirm queues.

jason: A/B plan: 25% traffic control (current page), 37.5% variant A (playful names + calculator), 37.5% variant B (utilitarian names + calculator). Run 10 days then quick retro.

build-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/pricing-bundle-3955556666 (flag: pricing_bundle_v3).

sophia: I'll craft the FAQ and the short benchmark appendix with numbers for chat/summarize/embed. Expect draft in 12 hours.

kate: OK team. Prep checklist: copy QA, design QA, dev wire, analytics hooks. Soft launch Fri 09:00 PT behind flag, post initial snapshot to #marketing-daily. Thanks :rocket:
